newsitem.title: USA: Colorado feedlot cattle trade slow -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Colorado feedlot cattle trade slow -USDA.

text.p: Trading of slaughter cattle slow Wednesday.
Slaughter steers and heifers not established. Week to date total includes 9,400 head sold on a contract or formula basis for this weeks' delivery.
Sales reported on 600 steers and 200 heifers.
Slaughter steers: Carcass basis: Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1350 lbs 105.00.
Slaughter heifers: Carcass basis: Select and Choice 2-3 1075 lbs 105.00.
Confirmed Sales: 800 Last Week: 900 Last Year: 2,900
Week to Date : 29,300 Last Week: 16,600 Last year: 23,200
